sufficiency.reason: The strongest hypothesis (conv_k7_r12_171_133) reached 10^-7.5, past the bar of 10^-7.1, and was then refused on a structural check: soft path metric 0.851 below floor 0.926.
sufficiency.what_would_prove_it: More of the same signal would not change this. The parity agreement was there but the hypothesis contradicts what the capture shows, which is how a coincidental fit is caught. A decode would need a hypothesis that is consistent with the observed modulation, block length and coverage.
